claims.text: SGLang Model Gateway v0.3.1 added cache-aware radix-tree routing, PrefixHash load balancing, JWT/OIDC authentication, classification APIs, and reliability/observability changes.
The release notes report 10–12x cache-routing speedups and roughly 99% lower per-node memory use in project benchmarks; these are project claims.

limitations.text: Performance and memory figures are project-reported and hardware/workload dependent.
This gateway release is infrastructure support rather than a new model or agent capability by itself.
